question: **Direction: Select the correctly spelt word. **
solution:
The correct answer is **"Contribute."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **'Contribute.'**
 
• It is spelt with a** 't'** after the **'n'** and an **'e'** at the end.
 
• The word means to give or supply something, especially money, in order to help achieve a common goal or purpose. (योगदान करना, अंशदान करना)
 
 
• **Example**: *I want to **contribute**__ to a charity fundraiser by donating some money.*
